## Objective

Build the Ørsted foundation and cable layers for SFW, RWF and SRW, and their
per-cell exposure covariates, for Phase 0 (`05_prepare_analysis.qmd`) to join
into the analysis tables and for the later phases to read on their own.

This was step 8 of `05` until 2026-10-28 (decision D-060). It needs only the
grid from `02_build_grid.qmd`, the leases and the Ørsted files: not the vessel
review (03) or the classified records (04). So it runs straight after 02, and
a change to the infrastructure data re-renders this notebook and 05 without
touching the vessel workflow.

| Output | One row per |
|---|---|
| `data/sf/infra/infrastructure.gpkg`, layers `foundations` and `cables` | foundation / cable route (EPSG:32619) |
| `data/processed/analysis/{pipeline}/infra_cell_static.csv` | cell: distance to the nearest eventual foundation and cable route (full precision) |
| `.../infra_cell_month.csv`, `.../infra_cell_season_year.csv` | cell × month / season-year: exposure covariates |
| `.../infra_cell_month_srw_planned.csv` | cell × month: the same, with SRW's 40 unrecorded positions installed (sensitivity) |
| `.../infra_cell_month_radii.csv`, `.../infra_cell_season_year_radii.csv` | cell × month / season-year: `n_found` and `active_construction` at the sensitivity radii (D-066) |

Every output has a `<file>.json` provenance sidecar. The source files under
`data/sf/owf/*/turbines/` are read only. Fields are defined in
`references/data_dictionary.md`.

The **gate** at the end collects every check; the notebook passes only if all
of them hold.

## Libraries and shared code

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)

source("r/paths.R")
source("r/gfw_helpers.R")
source("r/analysis_helpers.R")
source("r/infra_helpers.R")

# Quarto parameters (header); `params` is read-only while rendering. Run chunk
# by chunk, `params` is missing or left over from another session, so the
# header is read from this file directly instead
qparams <- if (isTRUE(getOption("knitr.in.progress"))) params else {
  hdr <- knitr::knit_params(readLines(
    file.path(root, "r/02a_infrastructure.qmd"), warn = FALSE))
  lapply(hdr, function(p) p$value)
}
paths <- gfw_paths_with(qparams)

crs_utm <- 32619 # WGS 84 / UTM zone 19N, the grid's CRS

# every check the gate needs, filled in as the steps run
gate <- tibble(check = character(), pass = logical())
check <- function(name, ok) {
  gate <<- add_row(gate, check = name, pass = isTRUE(ok))
  invisible(ok)
}
```

## Grid, calendar and nearest project

The three things the covariates need from the analysis setup, built the same
way as in `05` (steps 2 and 4): the grid, the months of the analysis window
with their season labels, and each cell's nearest project, whose timeline
sets the cell's `phase`.

```{r}
grid <- st_read(paths$grid, quiet = TRUE)
stopifnot("grid is not in EPSG:32619" = st_crs(grid)$epsg == crs_utm)

# one row per month of the analysis window, with the labels the season-year
# table is grouped by
calendar <- tibble(year_month = seq(analysis_start, analysis_end, by = "month")) |>
  mutate(season      = season_of(year_month),
         season_year = season_year_of(year_month))

# The leases are stored in EPSG:3857 and reprojected first
leases <- map_dfr(paths$leases, \(f) st_read(f, quiet = TRUE) |>
  st_transform(crs_utm) |>
  summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry)) |>
  mutate(project = tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f))))

# nearest project per cell centroid (the containing lease inside one)
cell_dist <- lease_distance(st_centroid(st_geometry(grid)) |> st_sf(), leases) |>
  mutate(cell_id = grid$cell_id, .before = 1)
count(cell_dist, nearest_project)
```

## Data and rules

The Ørsted turbine and cable data (plan, "Ørsted turbine and cable data")
come from three kinds of source, all read only:

| Project | Positions | Installation dates | Cables |
|---|---|---|---|
| SFW | layout GeoJSON (13 points) | Ørsted CSV (12 WTG + OSS Z01, one row per installation day), checked against PSO report Table 3 (`references/sfw_foundation_dates.csv`) | layout routes; works window from the PSO report |
| RWF | layout GeoJSON (67 points) | Ørsted foundation CSV (65 WTG + 3 OSS foundations) | layout routes; inter-array works from 2025-11 (open) |
| SRW | preliminary layout GeoJSON (85 points) | Ørsted foundation CSV (44 WTG + the OCS-DC jacket's 8 pin piles) | layout routes; no works dates |

Rules, each decided on 2026-10-19 unless dated otherwise (`planning/decisions.md`, D-022 to D-026):

- **Multi-day installations.** The foundation CSVs give one row per
  installation day, repeating the foundation's other fields. A foundation's
  `foundation_installed` is its first day and `foundation_end` its last, and
  its repeated rows must agree on structure, position and depth.
- **SFW** (decision 2026-10-20, D-032): Ørsted's `sfw_monopile_install_orsted.csv`
  ties each PSO monopile id (A01–A15, Z01) to its layout position and its
  installation days, so every SFW foundation has exact dates
  (`date_basis = "exact"`). It replaces the shared turbine window
  (2023-07-02 to 2023-08-07) used before this crosswalk existed. Its dates
  must equal PSO Table 3 (`references/sfw_foundation_dates.csv`), an
  independent source; the substation Z01 is on **AP06**, as inferred
  earlier from the export cable's landing point.
- **SRW's 40 layout positions with no installation record** are `planned`:
  work stopped in December 2025 and the January–April piling moratorium
  followed, so they never count as installed here. A sensitivity table
  treats them as installed in `srw_planned_from` (May 2026).
- **Cables** are static routes, plus coarse project × cable-type works
  windows from `references/infra_cable_windows.csv`. A window with no start
  (`complete_by`, `unknown`) never switches `cable_works` on.
- RWF, SRW and SFW positions take the CSV (as-installed) coordinates,
  checked against the layout points. SRW's layout names are truncated, so
  SRW positions are matched by distance. SFW positions are matched by
  distance too, and every SFW `USCG_ID` must then name its matched position
  (A01's, delivered as "AM0", was corrected to AM05 in the file on
  2026-10-20; the distance match is kept so a future truncation cannot
  misplace a foundation).
- **Safety zones** (decision 2026-10-20, D-034): the U.S. Coast Guard set a 500 m
  safety zone around every SFW, RWF and SRW foundation
  (`references/infra_safety_zones.csv`, one rule per project). A zone is
  active from its foundation's installation to its project's rule end: SFW
  2024-05-31; RWF 2027-05-31 and SRW 2028-05-31, so both stay on to the end
  of the window (turbine-erection dates were not supplied). Inside a zone,
  non-construction vessels are excluded by regulation, so lost effort there is
  mandated, not avoidance. The rules enforce the zones only during active
  construction, so an enforcement-only variant (installation days only) is
  kept for the Phase 7 sensitivity run.

Per cell × month covariates, from cell centroids (the safety-zone shares
from the cell polygons):

| Covariate | Definition |
|---|---|
| `sz_share` | share of the cell's area inside an active 500 m safety zone (installation to rule end) |
| `sz_share_install` | the same, counting a zone only on its foundation's installation days (enforcement-only sensitivity) |
| `d_found_km` | distance to the nearest foundation (turbine or substation) installed by the end of the month; NA before the first |
| `n_found_2km` | installed foundations within `r_count_km` |
| `active_construction` | a foundation's installation days overlap the month within `r_active_km` |
| `cable_works` | a cable route whose works window overlaps the month lies within `r_cable_km` |
| `phase` | the nearest project's `pre` / `construction` / `post_construction` |
| `months_since_first_found` | months from the nearest project's first foundation (event time) |

Substations count with turbines because a jacket or monopile is the same
seabed obstruction to gear. Two static covariates join `cells.gpkg` and every
table: `d_found_final_km` (nearest eventual foundation, planned included) and
`d_cable_km` (nearest cable route). The season-year table averages the
distances and counts over the season's months, gives the flags as shares of
months, and takes the phase held in most months.

## Sources

```{r}
# Foundation CSVs (RWF, SRW): one row per installation day, collapsed to one
# row per foundation spanning its first to last day (read_foundation_csv())
rwf_sheet <- read_foundation_csv(paths$rwf_foundations)
srw_sheet <- read_foundation_csv(paths$srw_foundations)

# SFW: Ørsted's monopile CSV (PSO id × position × installation day), the
# primary source, and the PSO report's Table 3 dates, transcribed, to check it
sfw_sheet <- read_sfw_csv(paths$sfw_foundations)
sfw_pso <- read_csv(paths$sfw_pso_dates, col_types = cols(.default = "c")) |>
  mutate(across(ends_with("_date"), as.Date))

# Layout files: every planned or built position (points) and cable route
# (lines). The 2-letter + 2-digit grid name (e.g. AM06) is the position key.
read_layout <- function(f, prj, type) {
  g <- st_read(f, quiet = TRUE)
  g[st_geometry_type(g) == type, ] |>
    transmute(project = prj, layout_name = str_squish(name), description) |>
    st_transform(crs_utm)
}
layout_pts <- imap_dfr(paths$layouts, \(f, prj) read_layout(f, prj, "POINT")) |>
  mutate(grid_pos = str_extract(layout_name, "^[A-Z]{2}\\d{2}"))
layout_lines <- imap_dfr(paths$layouts, \(f, prj) read_layout(f, prj, "LINESTRING"))
# version date of each layout file, from its name (e.g. ..._26-01-19.geojson)
layout_version <- map_chr(paths$layouts, \(f) format(as.Date(
  str_extract(basename(f), "\\d{2}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}(?=\\.geojson$)"), format = "%y-%m-%d")))

cable_windows <- read_csv(paths$cable_windows, col_types = cols(.default = "c")) |>
  mutate(across(c(lay_start, lay_end), as.Date))

count(st_drop_geometry(layout_pts), project, name = "positions")
check("layout grid names parse and are unique within each project",
      !anyNA(layout_pts$grid_pos) && !anyDuplicated(paste(layout_pts$project, layout_pts$grid_pos)))
```

## Foundations and cables

```{r}
# CSV coordinates (WGS 84) -> UTM points
sheet_sf <- \(d) st_as_sf(d, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326) |> st_transform(crs_utm)

# RWF: "B47/AK12" carries both the internal id and the grid position
rwf <- rwf_sheet |>
  mutate(internal_id = str_extract(foundation_id, "^[^/]+"),
         grid_pos = str_extract(foundation_id, "(?<=/)[A-Z]{2}\\d{2}"),
         asset_type = if_else(str_detect(structure, "OSS"), "oss", "wtg")) |>
  sheet_sf()
rwf_lay <- filter(layout_pts, project == "RWF")
rwf$layout_offset_m <- as.numeric(st_distance(
  rwf, rwf_lay[match(rwf$grid_pos, rwf_lay$grid_pos), ], by_element = TRUE))

# SRW: the converter station's 8 jacket pin piles become one foundation
srw_pins <- filter(srw_sheet, str_detect(foundation_id, "Pin Pile"))
srw <- srw_sheet |>
  filter(!str_detect(foundation_id, "Pin Pile")) |>
  mutate(asset_type = "wtg") |>
  bind_rows(srw_pins |> summarise(
    foundation_id = "OCS-DC", structure = "OCS-DC jacket (8 pin piles)",
    foundation_installed = min(foundation_installed), foundation_end = max(foundation_end),
    n_date_rows = sum(n_date_rows), lat = mean(lat), lon = mean(lon),
    depth_m = mean(depth_m), asset_type = "oss")) |>
  mutate(internal_id = foundation_id) |>
  sheet_sf()
# SRW layout names are truncated ("AS03 (C0"), so positions match by distance
srw_lay <- filter(layout_pts, project == "SRW")
srw_nn <- nearest_point(srw, srw_lay)
srw <- mutate(srw, grid_pos = srw_lay$grid_pos[srw_nn$b_row], layout_offset_m = srw_nn$dist_m)

# SFW: one row per monopile from Ørsted's CSV, with exact dates. Positions
# match the layout by distance, and a complete USCG_ID must then name the
# position it matched. (A01's id was delivered truncated as "AM0" and
# corrected to AM05 on 2026-10-20; matching by distance keeps any future
# truncation from misplacing a foundation, and lists it below.)
sfw <- sfw_sheet |>
  mutate(internal_id = foundation_id,
         asset_type = if_else(structure == "OSS", "oss", "wtg")) |>
  sheet_sf()
sfw_lay <- filter(layout_pts, project == "SFW")
sfw_nn <- nearest_point(sfw, sfw_lay)
sfw <- mutate(sfw, grid_pos = sfw_lay$grid_pos[sfw_nn$b_row], layout_offset_m = sfw_nn$dist_m)

sfw_id_complete <- str_detect(sfw$uscg_id, "^[A-Z]{2}\\d{2}$")
sfw |> st_drop_geometry() |> filter(!sfw_id_complete) |>
  select(internal_id, uscg_id, matched_position = grid_pos, layout_offset_m)
check("SFW: one CSV foundation per layout position, and every complete USCG_ID names its match",
      !anyDuplicated(sfw$grid_pos) && nrow(sfw) == nrow(sfw_lay) &&
        all(sfw$uscg_id[sfw_id_complete] == sfw$grid_pos[sfw_id_complete]))
check("SFW: the substation (Z01) is on AP06, where the export cable lands",
      identical(sfw$grid_pos[sfw$internal_id == "Z01"], "AP06"))
# two independent sources for every SFW date: Ørsted's CSV and PSO Table 3
sfw_vs_pso <- st_drop_geometry(sfw) |>
  full_join(sfw_pso, by = c("internal_id" = "pso_id"))
check("SFW: installation dates equal PSO report Table 3 for all 13 monopiles",
      nrow(sfw_vs_pso) == 13 &&
        isTRUE(all(sfw_vs_pso$foundation_installed == sfw_vs_pso$first_date &
                     sfw_vs_pso$foundation_end == sfw_vs_pso$last_date)))

# SRW positions with no installation record: planned (decision 2026-10-19, D-024)
srw_planned <- srw_lay |> filter(!grid_pos %in% srw$grid_pos) |>
  mutate(asset_type = "wtg", layout_offset_m = 0)

foundations <- bind_rows(
  rwf |> mutate(project = "RWF", date_basis = "exact", source = basename(paths$rwf_foundations),
                version_date = layout_version[["RWF"]]),
  srw |> mutate(project = "SRW", date_basis = "exact", source = basename(paths$srw_foundations),
                version_date = layout_version[["SRW"]]),
  sfw |> mutate(project = "SFW", date_basis = "exact", source = basename(paths$sfw_foundations),
                version_date = layout_version[["SFW"]]),
  srw_planned |> mutate(date_basis = "planned", source = basename(paths$layouts[["SRW"]]),
                        version_date = layout_version[["SRW"]])) |>
  mutate(asset_id = paste(project, coalesce(internal_id, grid_pos), sep = "-"),
         status = if_else(is.na(foundation_end), "planned", "installed"),
         # not supplied by Ørsted yet; kept so the layer has the plan's schema
         wtg_installed = as.Date(NA), first_power = as.Date(NA)) |>
  select(asset_id, project, asset_type, grid_pos, internal_id, status, date_basis,
         foundation_installed, foundation_end, n_date_rows, wtg_installed, first_power,
         depth_m, layout_offset_m, source, version_date)

foundations |> st_drop_geometry() |> count(project, asset_type, status)

# Cable routes as drawn in the layout files, with their project × type works
# window. An open window runs to the end of the analysis window.
cables <- layout_lines |>
  mutate(asset_type = if_else(str_detect(description, "Export"), "export_cable", "iac")) |>
  left_join(cable_windows, by = c("project", "asset_type")) |>
  mutate(asset_id = paste(project, asset_type, layout_name, sep = "-"),
         lay_end = if_else(date_basis == "open_window", analysis_end, lay_end),
         burial_complete = as.Date(NA),
         version_date = layout_version[project]) |>
  select(asset_id, project, asset_type, route_name = layout_name, lay_start, lay_end,
         burial_complete, date_basis, source, version_date)

st_drop_geometry(cables) |> count(project, asset_type, date_basis)

dated <- filter(foundations, status == "installed")
exact <- filter(dated, date_basis == "exact")
check("foundation counts: SFW 13, RWF 68 (65 WTG + 3 OSS), SRW 85 positions",
      identical(as.integer(table(foundations$project)[c("SFW", "RWF", "SRW")]), c(13L, 68L, 85L)))
check("SRW: 45 dated foundations (44 WTG + OCS-DC), each on its own layout position",
      sum(dated$project == "SRW") == 45 && !anyDuplicated(srw$grid_pos))
check("every CSV foundation within 100 m of its layout position",
      all(foundations$layout_offset_m < 100))
check("asset ids unique (foundations and cables)",
      !anyDuplicated(foundations$asset_id) && !anyDuplicated(cables$asset_id))
check("installation dates inside the analysis window, first <= last",
      all(dated$foundation_installed >= analysis_start & dated$foundation_end <= analysis_end &
            dated$foundation_installed <= dated$foundation_end))
check("exactly dated foundations installed within 31 days",
      all(exact$foundation_end - exact$foundation_installed <= 31))
# each foundation inside its own project's lease, with 100 m tolerance for
# as-built offsets at the lease edge
in_own_lease <- map2_lgl(st_geometry(foundations), foundations$project, \(g, prj)
  as.numeric(st_distance(st_sfc(g, crs = crs_utm), filter(leases, project == prj))) <= 100)
check("every foundation inside its own project's lease", all(in_own_lease))

dir.create(dirname(paths$infra), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
st_write(foundations, paths$infra, layer = "foundations", delete_dsn = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)
st_write(cables, paths$infra, layer = "cables", quiet = TRUE)
infra_inputs <- c(paths$rwf_foundations, paths$srw_foundations, paths$sfw_foundations,
                  paths$sfw_pso_dates, paths$cable_windows, paths$safety_zones,
                  unname(paths$layouts))
write_provenance(paths$infra, infra_inputs, extra = list(
  layers = c("foundations", "cables"), crs = "EPSG:32619",
  foundations = nrow(foundations), cables = nrow(cables),
  srw_planned = sum(foundations$status == "planned")))
```

## Exposure covariates

```{r}
ctr_pts <- st_centroid(st_geometry(grid))
d_fdn <- units::drop_units(st_distance(ctr_pts, foundations)) / 1000  # cells × foundations, km
d_cab <- units::drop_units(st_distance(ctr_pts, cables)) / 1000       # cells × routes, km
months <- calendar$year_month

# static: distance to the nearest eventual foundation (all positions, planned
# included) and to the nearest cable route of any project
infra_static <- tibble(cell_id = grid$cell_id,
                       d_found_final_km = apply(d_fdn, 1, min),
                       d_cable_km = apply(d_cab, 1, min))

# Project timeline. Works start on the first foundation or cable-lay day.
# They end on the last one only if every foundation is installed and every
# cable window is closed; otherwise the project is still in construction at
# the end of the window. min/max of no dates give ±Inf, reset to NA.
finite_or_na <- \(d) if_else(is.finite(d), d, as.Date(NA))
cw_tl <- cable_windows |> group_by(project) |>
  summarise(first_cable = finite_or_na(suppressWarnings(min(lay_start, na.rm = TRUE))),
            last_cable = finite_or_na(suppressWarnings(
              max(lay_end[date_basis == "project_window"], na.rm = TRUE))),
            cable_open = any(date_basis %in% c("open_window", "unknown")), .groups = "drop")
project_tl <- st_drop_geometry(foundations) |> group_by(project) |>
  summarise(first_found = min(foundation_installed, na.rm = TRUE),
            last_found = max(foundation_end, na.rm = TRUE),
            complete = all(status == "installed"), .groups = "drop") |>
  left_join(cw_tl, by = "project") |>
  mutate(works_start = pmin(first_found, first_cable, na.rm = TRUE),
         works_end = if_else(complete & !cable_open,
                             pmax(last_found, last_cable, na.rm = TRUE), as.Date(NA)))
project_tl

# phase and event time follow each cell's nearest project (step 4)
cell_phase <- cell_dist |> select(cell_id, nearest_project) |>
  left_join(project_tl, by = c("nearest_project" = "project")) |>
  cross_join(tibble(year_month = months)) |>
  mutate(phase = project_phase(year_month, works_start, works_end),
         months_since_first_found = months_between(year_month, first_found)) |>
  select(cell_id, year_month, phase, months_since_first_found)

# per cell × month foundation exposure, for one set of installation dates
build_exposure <- function(installed, end) {
  foundation_exposure(d_fdn, installed, end, months,
                      r_count_km = qparams$r_count_km, r_active_km = qparams$r_active_km) |>
    mutate(cell_id = grid$cell_id[cell], .keep = "unused", .before = 1)
}
cable_works <- cable_works_exposure(d_cab, cables$lay_start, cables$lay_end, months,
                                    r_km = qparams$r_cable_km)
# cells × months matrix -> long, column-major so cells vary fastest
cable_long <- tibble(cell_id = rep(grid$cell_id, length(months)),
                     year_month = rep(months, each = nrow(grid)),
                     cable_works = c(cable_works))

# USCG 500 m safety zones (decision 2026-10-20, D-034): one rule per project. A zone
# is active from its foundation's installation to its project's rule end;
# a planned foundation has none
sz_rules <- read_csv(paths$safety_zones, col_types = cols(.default = "c")) |>
  mutate(across(c(rule_start, rule_end), as.Date), radius_m = as.numeric(radius_m))
check("one 500 m safety-zone rule per project",
      setequal(sz_rules$project, c("SFW", "RWF", "SRW")) && all(sz_rules$radius_m == 500))
sz_rule <- sz_rules[match(foundations$project, sz_rules$project), ]
check("no foundation installed before its project's safety-zone rule took effect",
      all(is.na(foundations$foundation_installed) |
            foundations$foundation_installed >= sz_rule$rule_start))
sz_start <- foundations$foundation_installed
sz_end <- if_else(is.na(sz_start), as.Date(NA), sz_rule$rule_end)

# per cell × month area share inside active zones, under one set of zone dates
build_zones <- function(start, end, col) {
  safety_zone_share(grid, foundations, start, end, months, radius_m = unique(sz_rules$radius_m)) |>
    transmute(cell_id = grid$cell_id[cell], year_month, "{col}" := sz_share)
}
# main: installation to rule end; enforcement-only: installation days
sz_main <- build_zones(sz_start, sz_end, "sz_share")
sz_install <- build_zones(foundations$foundation_installed, foundations$foundation_end,
                          "sz_share_install")

infra_month <- build_exposure(foundations$foundation_installed, foundations$foundation_end) |>
  left_join(cable_long, by = c("cell_id", "year_month")) |>
  left_join(cell_phase, by = c("cell_id", "year_month")) |>
  left_join(sz_main, by = c("cell_id", "year_month")) |>
  left_join(sz_install, by = c("cell_id", "year_month"))

# sensitivity: the 40 planned SRW positions installed in `srw_planned_from`,
# each with its safety zone from then to the SRW rule's end
planned <- foundations$status == "planned"
sens_from <- as.Date(qparams$srw_planned_from)
infra_month_srw <- build_exposure(
  replace(foundations$foundation_installed, planned, sens_from),
  replace(foundations$foundation_end, planned, month_end(sens_from))) |>
  left_join(cable_long, by = c("cell_id", "year_month")) |>
  left_join(cell_phase, by = c("cell_id", "year_month")) |>
  left_join(build_zones(replace(sz_start, planned, sens_from),
                        replace(sz_end, planned, sz_rule$rule_end[planned]), "sz_share"),
            by = c("cell_id", "year_month")) |>
  left_join(build_zones(replace(foundations$foundation_installed, planned, sens_from),
                        replace(foundations$foundation_end, planned, month_end(sens_from)),
                        "sz_share_install"),
            by = c("cell_id", "year_month"))

n_col <- sprintf("n_found_%gkm", qparams$r_count_km)

# season-year: means of distances and counts, share of months for the flags
# (plan, @sec-infra); the phase held in most months, ties to the later phase
phase_levels <- c("pre", "construction", "post_construction")
modal_phase <- \(p) { tab <- table(factor(p, phase_levels)); phase_levels[max(which(tab == max(tab)))] }
infra_season_year <- infra_month |>
  left_join(select(calendar, year_month, season, season_year), by = "year_month") |>
  group_by(cell_id, season, season_year) |>
  summarise(d_found_km = if (all(is.na(d_found_km))) NA_real_ else mean(d_found_km, na.rm = TRUE),
            across(all_of(n_col), mean),
            active_construction_share = mean(active_construction),
            cable_works_share = mean(cable_works),
            # mean monthly area share inside active safety zones
            sz_share = mean(sz_share), sz_share_install = mean(sz_share_install),
            phase = modal_phase(phase),
            months_since_first_found = mean(months_since_first_found), .groups = "drop")

# cells exposed per month, by covariate
infra_month |> group_by(year_month) |>
  summarise(installed_nearby = sum(.data[[n_col]] > 0), active_construction = sum(active_construction),
            cable_works = sum(cable_works), safety_zone = sum(sz_share > 0),
            safety_zone_km2 = round(sum(sz_share * grid$area_km2[match(cell_id, grid$cell_id)]), 1),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(installed_nearby + active_construction + cable_works + safety_zone > 0) |>
  mutate(year_month = format(year_month, "%Y-%m")) |> knitr::kable()

# exposure only ever grows: once a foundation is in, it stays in
mono <- infra_month |> arrange(cell_id, year_month) |> group_by(cell_id) |>
  summarise(na_first = all(diff(is.na(d_found_km)) <= 0),
            d_ok = all(diff(d_found_km[!is.na(d_found_km)]) <= 1e-9),
            n_ok = all(diff(.data[[n_col]]) >= 0), .groups = "drop")
check("infrastructure covariates: one row per cell × month, no gaps but d_found_km",
      nrow(infra_month) == nrow(grid) * length(months) && !anyNA(select(infra_month, -d_found_km)))
check("d_found_km never increases or returns to NA; n_found never decreases",
      all(mono$na_first & mono$d_ok & mono$n_ok))
check("installed by August 2026: SFW 13, RWF 68, SRW 45",
      identical(as.integer(table(dated$project)[c("SFW", "RWF", "SRW")]), c(13L, 68L, 45L)))
check("no exposure before SFW's first works (cable lay from 2023-03)",
      !any(infra_month$active_construction[infra_month$year_month < as.Date("2023-03-01")]) &&
        all(is.na(infra_month$d_found_km[infra_month$year_month < as.Date("2023-06-01")])))

# safety zones: shares in [0, 1]; none before the first foundation (June
# 2023); SFW's zones lapse after 2024-05-31. The lapse is checked on cells
# touched only by SFW zones, since a cell can also lie in an RWF zone
zone_cells <- \(prj) grid$cell_id[lengths(st_intersects(
  grid, st_buffer(filter(foundations, project %in% prj, status == "installed"), 500))) > 0]
sfw_only <- setdiff(zone_cells("SFW"), zone_cells(c("RWF", "SRW")))
sz_sfw <- filter(infra_month, cell_id %in% sfw_only)
check("safety-zone shares lie in [0, 1], for both definitions",
      all(between(infra_month$sz_share, 0, 1)) && all(between(infra_month$sz_share_install, 0, 1)))
check("no safety zone before the first foundation (June 2023)",
      all(infra_month$sz_share[infra_month$year_month < as.Date("2023-06-01")] == 0))
check("SFW safety zones active through May 2024 and lapsed from June 2024",
      length(sfw_only) > 0 &&
        sum(sz_sfw$sz_share[sz_sfw$year_month == as.Date("2024-05-01")]) > 0 &&
        all(sz_sfw$sz_share[sz_sfw$year_month >= as.Date("2024-06-01")] == 0))
check("the enforcement-only zones never exceed the main ones",
      all(infra_month$sz_share_install <= infra_month$sz_share + 1e-9))
```

### Sensitivity radii

`n_found` and `active_construction` at half, the primary and double radius
(decision 2026-10-29, D-066), for the Phase 4 radius-recovery simulation and
the Phase 7 sensitivity runs (plan, "Simulation power analysis" and Phase 7). They
go in their own tables, one column per radius, so the primary tables, 05 and
the analysis tables are unchanged; a model swaps the column in. Recorded
installation dates only (no SRW-planned variant), and no `cable_works`, which
the sensitivity runs do not vary.

```{r}
# the YAML lists arrive as vectors when rendered and as lists when read by
# knit_params(), so flatten them; each set must contain its primary radius
r_count_sens <- sort(unlist(qparams$r_count_sens_km))
r_active_sens <- sort(unlist(qparams$r_active_sens_km))
stopifnot("r_count_sens_km must include r_count_km" = qparams$r_count_km %in% r_count_sens,
          "r_active_sens_km must include r_active_km" = qparams$r_active_km %in% r_active_sens)
count_col <- \(r) sprintf("n_found_%gkm", r)
active_col <- \(r) sprintf("active_construction_%gkm", r)

# one foundation_exposure() pass per radius (the cell × foundation distances
# are already in d_fdn, so each pass is cheap). Rows come out in the same
# cell × month order every time, so the columns can be bound side by side.
# Each pass varies one radius; the other is held at its primary value and
# its column dropped
exposure_at <- \(r_count, r_active) foundation_exposure(
  d_fdn, foundations$foundation_installed, foundations$foundation_end, months,
  r_count_km = r_count, r_active_km = r_active)
count_by_r <- map(r_count_sens, \(r) exposure_at(r, qparams$r_active_km)[[count_col(r)]]) |>
  set_names(count_col(r_count_sens))
active_by_r <- map(r_active_sens, \(r) exposure_at(qparams$r_count_km, r)$active_construction) |>
  set_names(active_col(r_active_sens))
infra_month_radii <- exposure_at(qparams$r_count_km, qparams$r_active_km) |>
  transmute(cell_id = grid$cell_id[cell], year_month) |>
  bind_cols(as_tibble(count_by_r), as_tibble(active_by_r))

# season-year, as for the main table: counts averaged, flags as shares of months
infra_season_year_radii <- infra_month_radii |>
  left_join(select(calendar, year_month, season, season_year), by = "year_month") |>
  group_by(cell_id, season, season_year) |>
  summarise(across(all_of(count_col(r_count_sens)), mean),
            across(all_of(active_col(r_active_sens)), mean, .names = "{.col}_share"),
            .groups = "drop")

# cell-months reached by each radius: how much exposure each choice gives the
# timing model to work with
infra_month_radii |>
  summarise(across(all_of(count_col(r_count_sens)), \(x) sum(x > 0)),
            across(all_of(active_col(r_active_sens)), sum)) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "column", values_to = "exposed_cell_months") |>
  knitr::kable()

# the primary radius reproduces the main table exactly (same rows, same order)
check("sensitivity radii: the primary radii reproduce n_found and active_construction exactly",
      identical(infra_month_radii$cell_id, infra_month$cell_id) &&
        identical(infra_month_radii$year_month, infra_month$year_month) &&
        identical(infra_month_radii[[count_col(qparams$r_count_km)]], infra_month[[n_col]]) &&
        identical(infra_month_radii[[active_col(qparams$r_active_km)]], infra_month$active_construction))
# a larger radius only ever adds exposure (columns are in increasing radius)
nested <- \(cols, ge) all(map2_lgl(cols[-length(cols)], cols[-1],
                                   \(a, b) ge(infra_month_radii[[b]], infra_month_radii[[a]])))
check("sensitivity radii: exposure never shrinks as the radius grows",
      nested(count_col(r_count_sens), \(b, a) all(b >= a)) &&
        nested(active_col(r_active_sens), \(b, a) all(b | !a)))
check("sensitivity radii: one row per cell × month and per cell × season-year, no gaps",
      nrow(infra_month_radii) == nrow(infra_month) && !anyNA(infra_month_radii) &&
        nrow(infra_season_year_radii) == nrow(infra_season_year) && !anyNA(infra_season_year_radii))
```

## Write the outputs

The covariate tables are rounded when written, to the decimals in
`infra_write_digits` (`r/infra_helpers.R`), which `05` applies to the same
columns of the analysis tables. `infra_cell_static.csv` is written at full
precision (17 significant digits), because `05` copies it into `cells.gpkg`,
which keeps full precision.

```{r}
dir.create(paths$analysis, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# season-year means of the counts and shares of the flags, at every radius
radii_cols <- c(count_col(r_count_sens), paste0(active_col(r_active_sens), "_share"))
write_digits <- c(infra_write_digits, set_names(3, n_col),
                  set_names(rep(3, length(radii_cols)), radii_cols))
round_written <- \(t) mutate(t, across(any_of(names(write_digits)),
                                       \(x) round(x, write_digits[[cur_column()]])))

# The static distances must reach cells.gpkg unchanged. readr writes and parses
# doubles inexactly (last-digit differences, ~1e-15 km), so they are written
# with 17 significant digits, which identify a double exactly; 05 parses them
# with as.numeric(), which is exact.
exact_chr <- \(x) sprintf("%.17g", x)
stopifnot("static distances have no gaps" = !anyNA(infra_static))

infra_out <- list(
  infra_cell_static = mutate(infra_static, across(where(is.double), exact_chr)),
  infra_cell_month = round_written(infra_month),
  infra_cell_season_year = round_written(infra_season_year),
  infra_cell_month_srw_planned = round_written(infra_month_srw),
  # sensitivity radii (D-066)
  infra_cell_month_radii = round_written(infra_month_radii),
  infra_cell_season_year_radii = round_written(infra_season_year_radii))

written <- tibble(file = character(), rows = integer())
for (nm in names(infra_out)) {
  f <- file.path(paths$analysis, paste0(nm, ".csv"))
  write_csv(infra_out[[nm]], f, na = "")
  write_provenance(f, c(paths$infra, infra_inputs, paths$grid, paths$leases), extra = c(list(
    rows = nrow(infra_out[[nm]]), r_count_km = qparams$r_count_km,
    r_active_km = qparams$r_active_km, r_cable_km = qparams$r_cable_km,
    srw_planned = if (nm == "infra_cell_month_srw_planned")
      paste("40 unrecorded SRW positions installed", qparams$srw_planned_from) else "planned, never installed"),
    # only the radii tables (D-066) record their radius sets, so the other
    # sidecars keep their fields unchanged
    if (grepl("_radii$", nm)) list(r_count_sens_km = r_count_sens, r_active_sens_km = r_active_sens)))
  written <- add_row(written, file = basename(f), rows = nrow(infra_out[[nm]]))
}
written
```

## Gate

The infrastructure layers match their sources (counts, positions within
100 m, dates in the window, every foundation in its own lease), the safety
zones follow their rules, and exposure only grows as foundations go in.

```{r}
gate |> mutate(pass = if_else(pass, "pass", "FAIL")) |> knitr::kable()

stopifnot("infrastructure gate failed; see the table above" = all(gate$pass))
```
